'''D22 Division''' was a [[Division/Legends|division]] in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The unit fielded [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Pocket Model TCG" />
